name: artifactory
description: JFrog Artifactory integration — list repositories, search artifacts (quick search or safely-constructed AQL), inspect artifact storage info and download stats, read and set item properties, browse builds, and view per-repository storage usage. Authenticates with a static JFrog access (identity) token sent as a Bearer header against {baseUrl}/artifactory/api.
author: Buildersoft LLC

fields.label: JFrog Platform URL
fields.helpText: Base URL of your JFrog Platform instance (cloud or self-hosted), without a trailing path — the skill appends /artifactory/api itself.

fields.label: Access Token
fields.helpText: A JFrog access token. Any user can self-generate an identity token from their profile (profile > Access Tokens). Storage summary needs an admin or system:info-scoped token.

tools.name: artifactory.list_repositories
tools.description: List repositories, optionally filtered by repository type (local, remote, virtual, or federated). Returns key, type, package type, and URL for each.

tools.name: artifactory.search_artifacts
tools.description: Search artifacts. Quick mode: pass name (optionally repos) for a name-based quick search — quick search only covers local and remote repositories, not virtual ones. AQL mode: pass repo, pathPattern, namePattern, and/or createdAfter — the skill builds a safe AQL query from these structured parameters (raw AQL strings are not accepted). Results always include repo, path, and name; capped at 100.

name.description: Quick search: artifact name (or fragment) to search for

repos.description: Quick search: comma-separated list of repository keys to search in

repo.description: AQL search: repository key to search in

pathPattern.description: AQL search: path wildcard pattern (e.g. org/acme/*)

namePattern.description: AQL search: file name wildcard pattern (e.g. *.jar)

createdAfter.description: AQL search: only items created after this ISO 8601 date (e.g. 2026-01-01)

tools.name: artifactory.get_artifact_info
tools.description: Get storage info for an artifact: size, checksums (including sha256), created and last-modified timestamps, and download URI. Set stats to true to also include the download count and last-downloaded time.

path.description: Path to the artifact within the repository (e.g. org/acme/app/1.0/app-1.0.jar)

tools.name: artifactory.get_item_properties
tools.description: Get the properties (key/value metadata) set on a repository item. Returns an empty map with a note when the item has no properties.

path.description: Path to the item within the repository

tools.name: artifactory.list_builds
tools.description: List all builds known to Artifactory (name and last build time). Pass buildName to list the numbers and start dates of a specific build instead.

buildName.description: Build name to list build numbers for

tools.name: artifactory.get_storage_summary
tools.description: Get per-repository storage usage (repo key, used space, items count, package type). Requires an admin token or a scoped token with system:info permission.

tools.name: artifactory.set_item_properties
tools.description: Set properties (key/value metadata) on a repository item. Requires Artifactory Pro; works on local repositories only. By default properties are applied to the given item only (recursive=0); pass recursive=true to also stamp every item beneath a folder.

repo.description: Repository key (must be a local repository)

path.description: Path to the item within the repository

recursive.description: When path is a folder, also apply the properties to every item beneath it (default false)
